# Security policy / Sicherheitsrichtlinie

<a name="english"></a>

## English

AeroDash is a development-stage prerelease. Include the affected version/commit and reproduction details in a report; this policy does not claim a stable 1.0 release or a guaranteed response time.

Report exploitable security vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private advisories](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/security/advisories/new), not public issues. Report calculation errors, wrong units, frozen UI and other operational safety defects through the [bug template](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), omitting personal/sensitive data.

<a name="deutsch"></a>

## Deutsch

AeroDash ist eine Vorabversion in Entwicklung. Version/Commit und reproduzierbare Schritte angeben; keine stabile Version 1.0 oder feste Antwortzeit zugesichert.

Ausnutzbare Sicherheitslücken privat über [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/security/advisories/new) melden. Rechenfehler, falsche Einheiten und Bedienausfälle über die [Fehlervorlage](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) melden; personenbezogene oder vertrauliche Daten weglassen.

<a name="français"></a>

## Français

AeroDash est une préversion en développement, sans engagement de délai de réponse. Indiquez la version/le commit et les étapes de reproduction. Signalez les vulnérabilités exploitables en privé via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/security/advisories/new), les erreurs de calcul ou d’unités via le [formulaire de bug](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), sans données personnelles ou sensibles.

<a name="español"></a>

## Español

AeroDash es una versión preliminar en desarrollo, sin plazo de respuesta garantizado. Incluya versión/commit y pasos para reproducir. Comunique vulnerabilidades explotables en privado mediante [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/security/advisories/new); errores de cálculo o unidades mediante el [formulario de errores](https://github.com/naturelle137/AeroDash/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), sin datos personales o sensibles.
